At 0.00 to 2.20 seconds the brush hovers above the rough blue sea while the final leaf remains softly visible through the window. From 2.20 to 4.80 seconds Johnsy dips the brush into a small amount of gold paint and lays one deliberate golden stroke across the blue sea. From 4.80 to 6.80 seconds she lifts her eyes from the paper toward the window and the steady leaf. From 6.80 to 8.00 seconds the gold stroke remains wet on the paper and her gaze holds a forward-looking stillness. Use a gentle slow push from the painting board to her hand and face, keeping the leaf in the distant background; one continuous take with no cut. No non-diegetic subtitles, captions, or dialogue text overlays appear at any moment.
